designDecision.unitOfWork: one register row per BELIEF-ABOUT-INPUT, not per function and not per file
designDecision.orderingRule: silent-wrong-value and silent-truncation first, then silent-skip, then vacuous/unfireable guards, then loud-throw (already-safe) rows last
designDecision.citationRule: every WHERE quotes lines opened via `git show origin/main:<path>`; anything not opened is CONFIDENCE: inferred with the reason stated
designDecision.preBakeDetectableRule: a probe against the SOURCE artifact (the StratMap zip, the county ArcGIS FeatureServer, the CAD export drop) or against a doc_repo catalog file, never against our own store

candidateFindingsAtCP1: DBF text encoding is hardcoded utf8 at cli.ts:168 and the .cpg is never extracted (TXGIO_ENTRY_FILTER is shp|dbf|prj only) — a non-UTF8 county silently mojibakes owner and situs strings
DBF attribute keys are read by exact case (p.Prop_ID, p.GEO_ID) — a county whose DBF header uppercases PROP_ID yields null identity for every feature with no guard counting it
extractZipEntries flattens every entry to basename — same-basename entries in different zip directories overwrite each other silently and can double-count under --multi-shp=concat

DECLARED_CAD_VINTAGES (vintage.ts:46) is a hand-typed 15-county mirror of _catalog/tx_cad_source_registry.json, which lives in a DIFFERENT REPO (doc_repo) and is read by no code; two further mirrors exist (routing.ts:26, verdictLayerServe.ts:82). Measured 0 divergences at this snapshot; there is no mechanism keeping it that way
isWebMercatorPosition (reproject.ts:100) documents that it catches a degree pair fed in by mistake; a degree pair passes it (|-97.7| <= 20037508). The guard cannot fire for its documented purpose

adversarialReviewOfOwnPlan.riskAccepted: a broad read at a few minutes per file will miss depth in the vendor parsers; the dispatch prices this explicitly (15-30 rows broad beats 5 exhaustive)
adversarialReviewOfOwnPlan.falsifierForThisCheckpoint: if the remaining files (p78Merge, normalize, pacs/orion/dcad/tad parsers, the Tier-1 bake) yield no silent-class row, the register is a restatement of the four already-fixed guards and is worth little
adversarialReviewOfOwnPlan.instrumentRisk: grep over a git ref can miss a symbol spelled differently; every claim of ABSENCE below is backed by an enumeration (git ls-tree / git grep -l over origin/main), never by an empty grep alone
